question: The Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI) released which edition of its publication titled 'Women and Men in India 2024: Selected Indicators and Data' in April 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**26th**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI) releases the publication titled **'Women and Men in India'** annually, providing key insights into gender-based indicators in India.
 
• In April 2025, MoSPI published the **26th edition** of this report, which continues its legacy of presenting statistical data on gender equality and demographic trends.
 
• The publication includes a wide range of indicators covering areas like education, health, employment, political participation, and other socio-economic parameters.
 
• This report is a critical tool for policymakers, researchers, and scholars to analyze and address issues related to gender inequality and to promote inclusive growth.
 
• The first edition of 'Women and Men in India' was released in 1995, and it has since become an authoritative source for gender-disaggregated data in the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The 'Women and Men in India' series is an important initiative by MoSPI to provide statistical data on gender disparities in India.
 
• It serves as a key resource for understanding the progress made in gender equality and identifying areas requiring policy intervention.
 
• The report aligns with India's commitment to achieving gender-related targets under the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
